description: This Java source file defines the ExampleRemoteClient class which demonstrates how to remotely access the Service Engine's RemoteDispatcher via RMI. It contains methods to connect to the RMI server, invoke a remote service, and handle exceptions. The class and its methods are used for remote service invocation testing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ExampleRemoteClient
classes.description: A client class demonstrating remote invocation of services via RMI in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ExampleRemoteClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RMI connection by looking up the RemoteDispatcher.

methods.name: runTestService
methods.description: Invokes a remote service 'testScv' with a message context and returns the result map.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that instantiates the client, calls runTestService, and logs the result.
